Hi Spencer,

Thanks for raising this. It's worth checking, and I'd rather confirm it than have you guess.

We make our units in US, EU and UK plug versions, and Australian orders are handled a bit differently depending on the item. Some come with an adapter in the box. I couldn't find your order from this message alone, so I don't want to tell you which lead you'll get until I've seen it.

I've passed this to a colleague, who is picking it up today and will confirm which lead or adapter ships with your order. To speed things up, you can reply with your order number (it starts with "Shop") and the postcode ····to.

Kind regards, Sarah

Hi Spence,

Thanks, I've found your order, Shop····, for two Harlo B30s going to (address hidden).

You'll be able to power them either way. The B30 has its power supply built in and runs on anything from 100 to 240 V, so Australian mains is fine. It connects with a standard kettle-style lead, the same detachable cable a desktop PC or monitor uses. If the lead in the box doesn't fit your socket, an Australian kettle lead plugs straight into the B30. Any electronics or hardware shop sells them for a few dollars.

I can't see which lead goes into an Australian box yet, so I've asked the team to confirm it for your order. They're offline now and will pick it up tomorrow at 10am US Eastern. Their answer will come to this email.

Kind regards, Sarah
